title: Northbeam TechWorks Arrears Note: Older Charges Falling Due with a Settlement
content:
An older charge on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job may fall due with a desk settlement. Only the fee for moving the slot does so, and how much of it falls due turns on whether a write-off on the retailer's own error stands against it.

**Where a fee for moving the slot stands on the job and no write-off on the retailer's own error stands against it**, that fee is due with the settlement in full.

**Where a fee for moving the slot stands on the job and a write-off on the retailer's own error stands against it**, what is left of that fee after that write-off is due with the settlement.

**Where neither situation holds**, nothing older is due with the settlement.

## The readings side by side

| A fee for moving the slot stands on the job | A write-off on the retailer's own error stands on it | Due with the settlement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | none | that fee in full |
| yes | at least one | what is left of that fee after that write-off |
| no | either | nothing |

What is left of the fee is never below nothing: where the write-off on the retailer's own error equals or exceeds the fee, nothing of it falls due.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**No slot-move fee at all.** Nothing older is due with the settlement.

**A slot-move fee partly written off on the retailer's error.** A hypothetical job carries a fee of 58.00 USD for moving the slot and a write-off of 22.40 USD on the retailer's own error. The second reading governs and 35.60 USD is due with the settlement.

**A slot-move fee more than covered by such a write-off.** With 67.00 USD written off on that ground against the same 58.00 USD fee, what is left of the fee is nothing, so nothing older is due.

**A slot-move fee with nothing written off on the retailer's error.** The first reading governs and the whole 58.00 USD is due with the settlement.
